We learned really quickly that a set nap schedule was just not going to work for us. And then around the 8 week mark we started using Huckleberry’s SweetSpot nap predictor and never looked back #ad

So let’s take a minute to chat through wake windows because this has truly made all the difference for us. And I’m not kidding when I say that 90% of the time Wes falls asleep within 5 minutes of his SweetSpot prediction. It’s actually wild lol.

I’d love to hear from other moms with 4ish month olds – how do you structure the nap schedule?

And if you want to try out @huckleberrycare download the free app through the link in my bio. New users get two weeks of free access to Premium membership to experience all the features!

#HuckleberryPartner #mothermood #wakewindows #firsttimemom
